items.title: Luhansk authorities report three killed in Ukrainian drone attack on residential buildings
items.summary: Russian-installed Luhansk leader Leonid Pasechnik said a Ukrainian drone attack struck apartment buildings in Yuvileine near Luhansk, killing three people and injuring six, including a child. Concrete floors reportedly collapsed in one building, and rescuers were searching for people who might remain trapped.

items.title: Russian deputy foreign minister rejects even quasi-NATO membership for Ukraine
items.summary: Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov said that even a form of quasi-membership for Ukraine in NATO would be unacceptable to Moscow. His statement underscores Russia's opposition to security arrangements resembling alliance membership.

items.title: Russia says no agreement reached on next round of Ukraine negotiations
items.summary: Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov said there is no agreement on holding another round of negotiations over Ukraine. He gave the statement in response to a question about the next stage of talks.
